threads.body: New behavior (overriding exception-log event name/severity for DB client instrumenters) isn’t covered by tests. Since this is user-visible under `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs`, it would be good to add a unit test that builds an Instrumenter with `setDbClientExceptionEventExtractor(...)`, ends it with an exception, and (when `emitExceptionAsLogs()` is true) asserts the exported log has eventName `db.client.operation.exception` and severity `WARN` (similar to `instrumentation-api/.../InstrumenterTest`).

replies.body: Added `DbExceptionEventExtractorsTest` in `instrumentation-api-incubator` (runs under the `testExceptionSignalLogs` task with `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs`). It builds an instrumenter with `setDbClientExceptionEventExtractor(...)`, ends it with an exception, and asserts the exported `LogRecordData` has event name `db.client.operation.exception`, `Severity.WARN`, and the exception attributes when `emitExceptionAsLogs()` is true (and no log when false). Also added an integration check (`AbstractJdbcInstrumentationTest.testFailedStatement`) with a per-module `testExceptionSignalLogs` Gradle task on the JDBC library + javaagent.

threads.body: [Testing] `testFailedStatement` creates a new JDBC `Connection` but never registers it with `AutoCleanupExtension`, so the connection may remain open after the test and leak resources (this class uses `cleanup.deferCleanup(connection)` in other tests).

replies.body:
Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/f16611e2294ec7c12f13a0f0a974175db2d31cfd.

Registered the test connection with AutoCleanupExtension next to its creation so it is closed after the test.
